question: Are all food items stored at correct temperatures?
Are raw and cooked foods separated?
Are all items properly labeled with dates?
Are storage areas clean and organized?
Are preparation surfaces clean and sanitized?
Are staff wearing appropriate PPE?
Are cutting boards color-coded correctly?
Is sushi rice at correct temperature?
Is fish fresh and within use-by date?
Is fish stored at correct temperature (0-4°C)?
Are there any signs of discoloration or odor?
Is sashimi-grade fish properly identified?
Are handwashing stations stocked and accessible?
Are floors clean and free of debris?
Are waste bins emptied regularly?
Is pest control up to date?
Are all refrigerators functioning properly?
Are thermometers calibrated?
Is dishwasher reaching correct temperature?
Are knives clean and stored safely?
